exposure: Prior term birth (caesarean section or vaginal delivery)
Women with a prior sPTB only
Women with a term birth preceding a sPTB
cohort: 430 women with a history of sPTB
finding: Women with a prior sPTB had a significantly higher risk of recurrent sPTB compared to women with a prior term birth.
mod_finding: Women with a prior spontaneous preterm birth had a higher risk of recurrent spontaneous preterm birth than those with a prior term birth, regardless of whether the term birth was cesarean or vaginal.
